description: Maritime Encoder Composite Score (MECS) Configuration & Justification Manifest
methodological_principle: MECS is an operational composite compatibility score for candidate ranking, not an intrinsic measure of domain understanding. All transforms are explicit design choices with documented justifications.

top1_acc.justification: Target benchmark ceiling of 35.0% strict word reconstruction accuracy for pre-trained zero-shot encoders on technical domain terminology without task-specific adaptation.

rare_top1_acc.justification: Target benchmark ceiling of 25.0% for low-frequency maritime domain words (corpus frequency <= 10) representing high-difficulty tail tokens.

top5_acc.justification: Target benchmark ceiling of 60.0% for top-5 word candidate recall under zero-shot cloze evaluation.

mlm_loss.justification: Fixed reference interval [3.0, 8.0] where 3.0 represents near-perfect domain MLM convergence (perplexity ~20) and 8.0 represents unadapted random guessing (perplexity ~2980 for 30k-50k vocabulary). Preserves linear cross-entropy sensitivity without cohort dependence.

fragmentation_rate_pct.justification: Natural percentage domain [0.0%, 100.0%]; lower fragmentation indicates superior morphological token preservation for maritime compounds.

oov_rate_pct.justification: 10.0% ceiling for out-of-vocabulary rate in WordPiece tokenizers. Byte-level BPE tokenizers have no measured OOV and are treated as NA (non-penalizing re-weighting).

category_balance.justification: Calculated as 1.0 - std(category accuracies) in [0.0, 1.0]; higher values denote uniform representation capability across subdomains.

inference_latency_ms.justification: Operational reference constant of 50.0 ms represents a standard interactive SLA ceiling for single-document real-time triage. Labelled as environment-specific operational metric dependent on benchmark hardware.

throughput_docs_sec.justification: Operational reference constant of 50.0 docs/sec reflects baseline batch ingestion throughput. Labelled as environment-specific operational metric dependent on benchmark hardware.

operational_metrics_note: Inference latency and throughput depend on benchmark execution hardware (NVIDIA GPU / PyTorch) and are explicitly classified as environment-specific operational metrics.
